# HINGETRA

> HINGETRA (operated by 铰拓五金有限公司) is a factory-direct manufacturer of industrial weld-on hinges for steel doors, gates, trailer doors, ramps, electrical cabinets and control cabinets. Standard catalog profiles plus custom hinges made to drawing.

Core facts: weld-on (weldable) hinges only, carbon steel, factory-direct supply, custom manufacturing to customer drawing, published catalog sizes with weights, RFQ-based quotation (no public price list).

## Product range

- [Bearing Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/bearing-weld-on-hinges/): 18 published catalog size/weight entries, drawings and RFQ.
- [Pin Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/pin-weld-on-hinges/): 5 published catalog size/weight entries, drawings and RFQ.
- [Grease Nipple Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/grease-nipple-weld-on-hinges/): 6 published catalog size/weight entries, drawings and RFQ.
- [Round Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/round-weld-on-hinges/): 6 published catalog size/weight entries, drawings and RFQ.
- [Adjustable Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/adjustable-weld-on-hinges/): 3 published catalog size/weight entries, drawings and RFQ.
- [Flag Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/flag-weld-on-hinges/): 9 published catalog size/weight entries, drawings and RFQ.
- [Gasket Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/gasket-weld-on-hinges/): 7 published catalog size/weight entries, drawings and RFQ.
- [20 Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/20-type-weld-on-hinges/): 2 published catalog size/weight entries, drawings and RFQ.
- [12 / 14 / 16 Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/12-14-16-type-weld-on-hinges/): 3 published catalog size/weight entries, drawings and RFQ.
- [Square Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/square-weld-on-hinges/): 1 published catalog size/weight entries, drawings and RFQ.

## How to specify a weld-on hinge enquiry

Send: hinge type or closest catalog size, pin/barrel diameter and length, leaf dimensions, door weight and dimensions, number of hinges and positions, quantity, material/finish requirement, and a drawing or marked sketch.
